recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中第 3 號染色體對的右側一條以箭頭標示長臂 q21 與 q26 兩處，兩斷點之間的條帶順序顛倒，其餘染色體與性染色體 XY 無明顯異常；這就是 inv(3)(q21q26.2)，牽涉 GATA2 增強子與 MECOM。
features: G-banded karyogram with 22 autosome pairs plus X and Y (male)
Two arrows on the long arm of one chromosome 3 mark breakpoints at 3q21 and 3q26.2
Altered band pattern between the breakpoints indicates a paracentric inversion within 3q
No other numeric or structural abnormality is evident at this resolution
describe_en: G-banded karyogram from the bone marrow shows a male complement with an abnormal chromosome 3, in which arrows mark breakpoints at 3q21 and 3q26.2 with an altered banding pattern consistent with a paracentric inversion of the long arm. No additional numeric or structural abnormalities are evident at this banding resolution, although subtle changes such as monosomy 7 frequently accompany this lesion and should be excluded in all metaphases analyzed. The karyotype is interpreted as 46,XY,inv(3)(q21q26.2), which repositions the GATA2 enhancer to drive MECOM overexpression. This finding defines AML with inv(3)(q21q26.2)/MECOM rearrangement, a high-risk genetic group.

ddx.vs: The balanced translocation involves both chromosome 3 homologs with exchanged segments, whereas an inversion alters only one homolog; both produce the same GATA2-MECOM juxtaposition.
These involve a partner chromosome other than 3 and carry different WHO classification implications.
Comparison with the normal homolog and FISH with a MECOM break-apart probe confirm a true rearrangement.
